title: 12 Best Tea Houses in Casablanca
description: Discover the finest tea houses in Casablanca, from historic Moroccan havens to elegant French patisseries. Find your perfect spot for mint tea, pastries, and cultural immersion.

places.name: Pâtisserie Bennis Habous
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any assortment of Moroccan Fekkas or Kaab el Ghazal (gazelle horns) with a piping hot glass of Moroccan mint tea.

places.name: La Sqala
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Sqala Tea Ceremony' which includes a pot of Moroccan mint tea and an assortment of local cookies and pastries.

places.name: Pâtisserie Amoud
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Tarte au Citron Meringuée' (Lemon Meringue Tart) or a selection of mini Moroccan pastries, paired with Moroccan mint tea or a classic Earl Grey.

places.name: Maârif Pastry
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of 'Briouats' (sweet almond pastries) and a glass of hot Moroccan mint tea.

places.name: Le Casablanca Hotel Tea Lounge
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Afternoon Tea Set' which includes a variety of savory and sweet bites, along with your choice of tea.

places.name: Paul
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Pain au Chocolat' or 'Macaron' with a 'Thé à la Menthe' (mint tea) or a 'Thé Noir' (black tea).

places.name: Rick's Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Moroccan Mint Tea, to fully embrace the local culture within the iconic setting.

places.name: Othmane Pastry
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Sellou' (a sweet, nutty paste) or a 'Chabakia' (honey cookie) with a traditional Moroccan mint tea.

places.name: Dar Dada
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of traditional Moroccan mint tea served with a plate of their homemade Moroccan cookies.

places.name: L'Etoile Centrale
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Thé à la Menthe' and a 'Mille-feuille' (Napoleon pastry) while watching the city go by.

places.name: Pâtisserie La Comtesse
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Opéra Cake' or a 'Religieuse' with a traditional Moroccan mint tea or a delicate green tea.

places.name: Palais Dar Souiri
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A traditional Moroccan 'Thé à la Menthe' served in a silver teapot with a selection of regional 'Ghoriba' cookies.
